sample_object_from_receptacle: build a python module to sample an object from a set and place it in a Habitat simulator scene receptacle
sample_receptacle_with_tilt_culling: create a function that samples a receptacle from the scene and culls tilted ones by gravity alignment tolerance
sample_placement_with_snap_down: build a python module to sample object placement on a receptacle with optional physics snap-down stabilization
check_object_accessibility: create a function that checks if a sampled object is within a threshold distance of the nearest navigable navmesh point
sample_multiple_objects_in_scene: build a python module to sample multiple objects into receptacles with configurable min and max object count
